Specifies ignored directories for metadata and PDFs in version control.

# Purpose
The file specifies paths to be ignored by a version control system. The paths `/metadata/*` and `/pdfs/*` indicate that all files and directories within the `metadata` and `pdfs` directories should not be tracked. This is typically used to exclude generated files or files not relevant to the source code from version control.
